**Skates P8 6.0: the new app**

Short version: this is the new Skates app that replaces the old one. It has a new window, a new map, Markers on the screen, a DClone board and many small things made easier. The old app got its last update (6.0.0) and keeps working for now, but this is the app to use from here on.

## New

**A new window**
- A clean, flat layout on every screen, with a quieter top bar: KILL D2R, KILL STEAM, RESTART, PAIR, HELP and REQUEST FEATURE.
- Press and drag on empty background to move the window.
- Hover tips are in the app's own look.

**A new map**
- The map is drawn on your own PC from your own Diablo II: Resurrected install, with the game's own minimap pieces. The first map of a game takes a few seconds, after that each area appears as you need it.
- Neighbouring areas stay in the same act, and the map fades around your character.
- If the app cannot find your game, it says so on screen instead of showing an empty map.

**Markers**
- Rings with a picture, and at the window's edge an arrow, the name and the distance in yards, for quests of all five acts, the way on and back, waypoints, red portals, experience shrines, super chests, and bosses, uniques and champions.
- They work with the map open or closed. Turn them on and off with **F9** or **Markers on/off** in the Map hack strip.
- The **MARKERS** screen sets what shows, its colour, size and how many.
- Hover a monster and a strip shows its resistances and its life as a percent. Auras you pick (Conviction and Fanaticism by default) raise an alert on its marker.

**DClone board**
- The **DCLONE** button in the top bar opens the board: both game versions, all four types (SCL, HCL, SCNL, HCNL) and NA, EU and KR for each. Hover to look, click to keep it open.
- Click a type to pin it, and its numbers sit in the top bar on every screen.

**Overview and Quick Launch**
- Quick Launch is one row of four buttons, and a new row appears when you use them all, up to sixteen. Right-click a button to set, change or remove its hotkey.
- **+ ASSIGN HOTKEY** lists everything that can still get a key: actions, your macros and your Quick Launch slots. The Hotkeys panel folds shut and remembers it.
- Click a game window to open a small menu with its roles.
- **REQUEST FEATURE** sends a short note straight to me.

**Accounts, items and assist**
- Move accounts by dragging them.
- Items: containers are drawn, and **COPY IMAGE** copies an item picture.
- Prebuff is set up under Assist.
- Hover a plain or superior Warlock book or Necromancer head on the ground and the tooltip shows.

**Guide**
- A friendly guide on the side of the window knows the screen you are on, shows you where things are and walks you through the app. The **HELP** button opens and closes it.

**A smaller download**
- Parts of the app that were no longer used are not packed in. Nothing you use is removed.

## Fixed

- **The mouse stuck in the game after a macro.** The mouse now goes back to the game the moment a macro ends.
- **Booking a team** now needs you to be logged in with Discord, so the booking is always yours.

## Good to know

- This app installs next to the old one and does not replace it. Settings and hotkeys are shared, so only run one of the two at a time.
- The map needs your Diablo II: Resurrected installed on the same PC.
- The first start can take a moment while the map is prepared.

Tickets and feedback are always welcome. Use **REQUEST FEATURE** in the top bar.
